Annotate ECM niches using ScType

Source: R/ecm-annotation.R
annotate_ecm_niches.Rd

Classifies each spot into an ECM niche (e.g. Interstitial, Basement membrane) using the ScType algorithm with ECM-specific marker genes.

Usage

annotate_ecm_niches(seurat_obj, markers_path = NULL)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object with SCT assay

markers_path

Path to Excel file with ECM niche markers. If NULL, uses built-in markers from inst/extdata.

Value

Seurat object with ecm_niche column in metadata (and ecm_domain_annotation retained as an alias for backward compatibility).

Details

The function requires scaled SCT data. If the object lacks an SCT assay, run Seurat::SCTransform() first.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seurat_obj <- annotate_ecm_niches(seurat_obj)
table(seurat_obj$ecm_niche)
} # }
